name: notebook-save-cleaner
description: Clean Jupyter execution counts and metadata on save while keeping outputs.

commands.title: Notebook Save Cleaner: Clean Current Notebook
Notebook Save Cleaner: Enable for This Workspace

notebookSaveCleaner.enabled.description: Enable automatic cleaning in this workspace. Manual cleaning remains available.

notebookSaveCleaner.trigger.description: Clean before saving, or only via the command.

notebookSaveCleaner.clearExecutionCounts.description: Clear both cell execution_count and output executionCount.

notebookSaveCleaner.clearNotebookMetadat.description: Remove notebook metadata except preserved keys.

notebookSaveCleaner.preserveNotebookMeta.description: Top-level notebook metadata keys to keep (widgets preserves interactive output state).

notebookSaveCleaner.clearCellMetadata.description: Remove cell metadata except preserved keys. Attachments and cell IDs are always retained.

notebookSaveCleaner.preserveCellMetadata.description: Top-level cell metadata keys to keep. vscode can contain cell language information.

notebookSaveCleaner.clearOutputMetadata.description: Clear display metadata while preserving output types, data and transient display IDs.

notebookSaveCleaner.preserveOutputMetada.description: Top-level output metadata keys to keep (for example image/png for image dimensions).

notebookSaveCleaner.skipWhileRunning.description: Skip cleaning when execution is observed or Jupyter reports a non-idle kernel. Save again after execution finishes.

notebookSaveCleaner.clearExecutionTiming.description: Remove cell metadata.execution and metadata.ExecuteTime timing records. Preserve other metadata by default.
